plans.name: HealthSpring True Choice (PPO)

moop.notes: In-network medical maximum; Part D and excluded services do not count. Combined in/out-of-network maximum is $10,100.

dental.notes: $800 shared yearly preventive/comprehensive allowance, in/out-of-network combined. Any US-licensed dentist; billing and reimbursement rules apply.

specialist.notes: In-network specialist copay. Read service-specific rules.

hospital.notes: One modeled in-network seven-day admission: $400/day for days 1–5; $0/day for days 6–90.

vision.notes: $100 yearly eyewear allowance, in/out-of-network combined, for one set. Read eligible-item rules.

benefit_review_notes.otc: No OTC allowance verified in the checked plan sources; this is not a confirmed $0 benefit.
benefit_review_notes.transportation: Annual free routine rides remain unverified. Ambulance and transplant travel benefits are separate.

drug_costs.conditions: Preferred network retail, 30-day supply, initial coverage. Standard retail Tier 1 is $10 and Tier 2 is $20; mail-order and longer supplies may differ. Exact pharmacy, coverage stage and Extra Help require confirmation.
drug_costs.deductible_note: $0 deductible for Tiers 1–2. $500 deductible for Tiers 3–5; full drug cost applies until the deductible is met.

plans.network_mapping_status: 2027 network mapping unavailable; older-year records are not used.
plans.scope_note: HealthSpring is the former Cigna Medicare business. Pilot: this one 2027 NC plan only. Formulary entries may group strengths/forms; confirm the exact prescription in the source. OTC and routine transportation amounts are unverified. Live 2027 provider/facility coverage is not connected.
